## Summary
Principal Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience across Node.js/NestJS, Python/FastAPI, React/Next.js, Angular, and AWS. Has architected systems serving 12M+ users, including a file platform (CloudDrive) processing 500K+ operations daily; reduced API latency by 45%; led a zero-downtime migration of 50M+ records; and designed a centralized AI middleware / MCP server layer for Claude and OpenAI-based document intelligence and conversational workflows. AWS Certified Developer – Associate.

## Experience
- Biztree — Principal Software Engineer (Jan 2023–Present, Remote/Canada): Architected a multi-tenant microservices platform for 5+ SaaS products serving 12M+ users, cutting backend development effort by 40%. Built CloudDrive (500K+ daily file operations, RBAC, S3 + Lambda). Designed a centralized AI middleware and MCP server layer for Claude/OpenAI-based document intelligence and conversational workflows, with structured outputs, secure tool access, token tracking, and subscription enforcement. Led a zero-downtime migration of 50M+ MongoDB records. Reduced API latency 45% with BullMQ and RabbitMQ.
- ConvertSite (ConvertCalculator) — Senior Software Engineer (Jun 2024–Aug 2025, Remote/Netherlands, part-time contract): Full-stack engineer on a no-code SaaS for calculators, quote forms, and pricing engines. Led the shift from a drag-and-drop builder into a prompt-driven AI experience that generates calculators, quote forms, and landing pages from user intent; shipped integrations for WordPress, Shopify, Wix, and Framer.
- InvoZone — Senior Software Engineer (Oct 2021–Jan 2023, Lahore, Pakistan): Delivered enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) features for RevBits — credential vaulting, session recording, session forensics. Designed high-availability microservices with load balancing and clustering. Hardened against XSS, SQL injection, and brute-force attacks. Contributed to a 2022 Globee Gold Award-winning product.
- TenX — Software Engineer (Aug 2018–Oct 2021, Lahore, Pakistan): Built systems for Ancera (food safety — 50% faster microbial-analysis processing) and Arccos Golf (real-time sports analytics — 40% improved shot-strategy accuracy). Implemented CI/CD that doubled release frequency.
